rationale: The protected multi-omic fingerprint is scientifically plausible and supported by guidance/rodent data but lacks critical experimental validation to serve as a CMC gate. Proceed to targeted testing: validate analytical sensitivity on low-biomass capture eluates, confirm the exogenous spike-in reliably mimics endogenous intact EV recovery/protection, demonstrate detergent+protease splits discriminate luminal cargo from resilient non-vesicular co-isolates with orthogonal imaging/density/single-particle assays, and perform blinded >=3–lot reproducibility plus short-interval in vivo/functional bridging before any comparability use.
